verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Migration Assistant moves data from a Windows PC to a Mac (macos-docs-2, macos-docs-20) and that Setup Assistant signs you in to your Apple Account (macos-docs-14). That covers the 'bring my data' part, but nothing shows online accounts syncing calendars or contacts to the desktop. missing for 10: documented online/internet-accounts integration (e.g., Google/Exchange/iCloud) for calendar and contacts sync, evidence that switchers' online calendars and contacts appear in desktop apps, independent or hands-on corroboration.
